subject: Q3 health check: team status, ask list, and target resets
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 health check: team status, ask list, and target resets

Team —

Attached is our quick Q3 health snapshot and the live tracker (attachments). I ran a brief pass across the OKRs and pulled the items I think need leadership attention before the QBR prep next week. High level: we’re on-track on feature parity and launch milestones, but two objectives are at risk and require either resource or scope changes.

Summary (high level):
- Obj A: “Reduce 95th perc. inference latency by 15%” — current progress 55% toward target; primary blocker is Dedicated pool capacity (we're seeing queueing on p99 tails during synthetic load).
- Obj B: “Lower serving unit cost by 20%” — largely on track for batching and cache changes, but quantization rollout needs model validation work (R&D) which is behind by ~2 sprints.
- Obj C: “Onboard 3 enterprise pilots” — 2/3 confirmed; third pipeline needs legal/pricing alignment.

Asks (what I need from you):
1) Marcus — can you confirm availability for adding 2 g4dn-equivalent GPUs to the us-west Dedicated pool for a 3-week ramp (to handle our staged perf validation)? If not possible, we need to re-scope Obj A to a 10% latency improvement and document fallback plan.
2) Laura — please review the suggested re-scope doc tab in the tracker (column H). If you agree, we should make a formal change request for the QBR notes.
3) Vivek — any flexibility on a one-time spend to accelerate the quantization validation (consulting + CI runtime time)? If we can budget it now, Obj B stays path-to-target.
4) Evelyn — can you coordinate with Product Marketing to push conservative QBR messaging (call out runway and mitigations) — target draft by Friday.

I’ve linked the tracker and a 1-pager in the Drive link and included the snapshot PDF for quick reading. I’ll be consolidating responses into a single decision doc by Thursday EOD so we can lock slides Friday morning.

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: okr_health_snapshot_q3.pdf (summary slide), okr_tracker_q3.csv (live tracker)

My notes:
- I agree to re-scope Obj A to 10% if Marcus confirms no spare capacity. Let’s write both options on the slide (A: 15% w/extra pool, B: 10% without).
- For Obj B, can we break the validation into two milestones: internal quantization safety sign-off (internal only) and external pilot validation? That reduces risk to shipping the batching/caching improvements without delaying the shipping cadence.
- Obj C: Legal needs the pricing template (I’ll ping Legal) — ask: Monica’s team contact? (I don’t have directly.)

Action items for me: I’ll draft the re-scope slide and drop into the tracker by EOD Wed. Marcus — if you can confirm infra by tomorrow noon that helps.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q3 health check: team status, ask list, and target resets

Laura / Steph —

Short answer: we have a tight maintenance window next week but I can reallocate 2 x g4dn-equivalent instances from a burst pool for a 3-week ramp starting Mon 7/20. I need a formal INC ticket so CloudOps can schedule and monitor the change.

I created a placeholder: INC-8729 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INC-8729) — please add the approval and the requested time window + owner. If everyone OKs the ramp plan, CloudOps will proceed. If for any reason the pool is still constrained, we fallback to the re-scope and Marcus will surface the telemetry summary for the QBR slide.

Also: Vivek — estimated one-time budget for external validation + temporary CI machines is ~$28k. If you can provision it from the Ops reserve, that buys us two 2-week validation cycles.

-Marcus

Attachments referenced: perf_queue_log_excerpt.txt (log snippet), ramp_plan.md (internal note)

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the rough estimate. Approving the one-time spend from the Ops reserve is fine; please include an itemized expense breakdown in INC-8729 so Finance can tag it correctly.

On the GPU ramp: I approve reallocating the burst pool for the 3-week ramp starting 7/20. Marcus — please confirm the exact instance types and monitoring hooks (I want CPU/gpu/queue p99 dashboards added to the CloudOps runbook).
